decision_table.name: Determine_HI_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Hawaii state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in HI (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Hawaii filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Form N-30 Instructions Reference: HI Rev. Stat. § 235-1 et seq. (Corporate Income Tax)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Hawaii filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Economic Nexus Guidance
No Hawaii nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_HI_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Hawaii state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Hawaii state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback - State-specific modifications per Hawaii tax law
Subtractions may include: - Hawaii net operating loss deduction - Interest on Hawaii and other municipal bonds
Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Form N-30 Instructions Reference: HI Rev. Stat. § 235-7 (Adjustments to Federal Taxable Income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_HI_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Hawaii state corporate income tax. Applies 6.4% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Hawaii state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to HI: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. HI taxable income: = [Result] 6. HI tax rate: × 6.4% 7. HI income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. HI credits: - [Credits] 9. HI tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: Hawaii Form N-30 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Corporate Income Tax Guide Reference: HI Rev. Stat. § 235-71 (Tax rate: 6.4%)
No Hawaii nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Hawaii taxable income - no tax liability. Hawaii NOL rules may apply (not implemented).
